title: OVERTON PLURALISTIC REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: Generation of pluralistic responses, including religious perspectives on social issues, as part of a broader set of human values.
findings: The OP-GRPO method enables models to successfully generate pluralistic responses that include religious perspectives (e.g., a Christian viewpoint on drinking alcohol) as part of a diverse set of human values, without explicit prompting.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. Persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models. In Proceedings of the 2021 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society, pages 298–306, 2021.
